## Gap ID
SEC-006

## Source
gap-analysis-security

## Description
The LocalExecutor BYOS subprocess wrapper has a 600s timeout but no CPU/memory limits. A buggy or malicious user script could exhaust system resources (CPU, memory, file descriptors) without any containment.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/work.py` — subprocess.Popen with timeout only
- No `resource.setrlimit` calls
- No cgroups isolation

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
Add `resource.setrlimit` to the BYOS subprocess wrapper in `work.py`. Set reasonable defaults for `RLIMIT_CPU`, `RLIMIT_AS`, `RLIMIT_NOFILE`. Allow override via `--byos-resource-limits`.

## Labels
gap-analysis, security, byos, major
